title: Kafka failover: West → East
description: Reverse direction of DEMO-06: suspends the 3 West brokers, proves East keeps serving. The more demo-worthy direction — the whole ecosystem tier (Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Connect, ksqlDB) is `kafka-east`-pinned, so they all keep serving uninterrupted while West is down.

observe.what: direction · suspended brokers · target-served boolean · probe token · RTO seconds · recovery state
stays reachable + responsive throughout (kafka-east client; unaffected by West outage)
stays reachable + the same produce/consume round-trip continues to work

whatProves: Phase 0.H's bidirectional DR holds in both directions; the ecosystem tier (SR · REST · Connect · ksqlDB) is unaffected by a West outage (observed RTO ~13.57s in v0.5.0).
